description:
GetLeads.io Agent allows this AI Digital Employee to securely connect with the GetLeads.io B2B contact database (402M+ contacts) and find/enrich people using natural language.
The agent can enrich a person by work email, LinkedIn profile URL, or name + company/domain; search, count, and export contacts from the database with rich firmographic/role/location filters; and look up filter enum values, strictly based on the permissions granted to the connected GetLeads.io API key.
